title: Tongue-reach direction decoding from ALM
disposition_reason: The preserved ALM package implements a prospective mouse-level direction scorer, source mapping reader and matched-arm packet construction. Its public entry is status-only: authentic per-recording mappings, eligible-case roster, isolated provider and executed references remain absent. Activate those inputs before treating this source as a runnable decoding benchmark.

scientific_target.question: Can retrospective premovement ALM calcium observations distinguish the instructed tongue-reaching direction across whole held target blocks, and separately across anatomically aligned held mice, beyond previous direction/reward, movement history and session time?
scientific_target.known_answer: The source trial direction in the complete ordered 4×4 or 5×5 target layout, expressed as a probability vector over all16 or all25 native directions. Current query labels are evaluator-only.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Mapped source trial direction and physical grid metadata; the authenticated per-file mapping and eligible trial inventory have not been issued. A decoder prediction is compared to this behavioral target, not to a paper table.
scientific_target.case_unit: One held repeated-target block within a session, or one held mouse in one physical layout; scored trials are nested observations.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Mouse; sessions, target blocks, trials and cells within mouse are dependent.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective decoding from tracking-onset-aligned calcium. The source enforces [-0.5,-0.1]seconds and full exposure/preprocessing support; it does not predict an unknown future movement onset online. Held-block and held-mouse claims remain separate.
exclusions: No merging16-class and25-class outcomes into one label space.
No claim that the source release census equals a qualified number of eligible mice/trials.
No causal ALM mechanism or direct-model understanding inference from programme accuracy.

inputs: Prospective source-derived dF/F window means from segmentation-QC ROIs, with complete frame exposure and preprocessing support inside the fixed premovement interval.
Training labels only; query features use session ROI axes for held blocks or externally established anatomical bins for held-mouse transfer.
Separate declared feature families: neural, prior-direction/reward/history-speed/session-time nuisance, and their combination. Nuisance history must end before the neural window.
forbidden_inputs: Current direction-coded events, query labels, source identities and answer-bearing trial metadata.
Current/future movement, contact/reward outcomes, support outside the allowed interval, or test-mouse tuning used to align axes.
Whole-session or query-fitted scaling and outcome-dependent cell selection.
observation_contract.case_identity: Source trial identity is(mouse,session,trial_id); public case and trial IDs are keyed HMAC digests. Fold source IDs are block:mouse:session:block or mouse:layout:mouse. No genuine emitted ID roster exists yet.
observation_contract.split: Implemented design: whole target blocks with their immediately adjacent blocks embargoed; separate leave-one-mouse-out by physical layout with independent anatomical alignment. The training fold must contain every direction; deficient folds receive non-estimable dispositions.
observation_contract.coverage: Loader requires dispositions for the reported61 behavior/imaging files and15 mice, including the52-session/13-mouse stimulation subset shared with NEURAL-044. Actual eligible counts and emitted cases remain unknown. Both layouts, split claims and access arms are conditions of this one registration.

primary.name: Mouse-macro balanced accuracy by physical layout and split claim
primary.aggregation: Pool all held-out trial predictions within each mouse before class recall; average mouse scores equally. Report observed test classes and never pool16/25-class spaces or held-block/held-mouse results.
primary.rationale: Measures recovery of the measured behavioral target while avoiding trial-count weighting and block-average recall artifacts.

secondary: Mouse-macro log loss with probability clipping at1e-15.
Paired neural-minus-history/time and combined-minus-history/time differences on identical held trials; competence is not implied by chance-level accuracy.
Per-mouse class support, full trial/fold dispositions, and whole-block label-rotation diagnostic.

comparators.name: Training class prior
comparators.procedure: Implemented Laplace-smoothed frequency vector repeated for every query.

comparators.name: History/time logistic reference
comparators.inputs: Prior direction, previous reward, prior movement speed and session time
comparators.procedure: Implemented train-only StandardScaler plus balanced logistic regression, fixed C=1; match query IDs and all limits.

comparators.name: Neural and neural-plus-history logistic references
comparators.inputs: Allowed dF/F features alone or concatenated with nuisance features
comparators.procedure: Implemented fixed C=1 reference; scaling on training only, convergence required, no outcome-selected hyperparameters.

nuisance_controls: Embargo adjacent repeated-target blocks; isolate all sessions of a held mouse.
Keep the full16/25-direction spaces and disclose unsupported classes instead of binary recoding.
Tracking-defined onset and exposure/support checks exclude post-onset leakage; ROI QC may use segmentation only.
Deterministic whole-block label rotation is a diagnostic, not a randomization p-value.
evaluation.uncertainty: Implemented approximate95% t intervals across mice when at least two are scoreable; one mouse has no population interval. Cross-validation training overlap and small mouse count limit interpretation; report paired mouse effects and no cell/trial pseudoreplication.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require exact case/trial IDs, class order, full probability count and finite simplex rows. Preserve all source/trial/fold exclusions and missing classes. Do not silently average only successful blocks or delete failed actors.

implementation.scorer_target: grading.score_prediction_cohort pools held-out predictions within mouse and scores true source direction labels as balanced accuracy/log loss; this is a genuine behavioral decoding target. Internal operator calls it after both arm submissions are committed.
implementation.delivered_scope: Complete prospective scientific modules and packet/scorer source are preserved, including distinct held-block and held-mouse claims. No genuine native mapping provider or public run/score route is delivered.
missing: Authenticated61-file source roster, per-recording native field/clock/onset/ROI mappings, and eligible trial census.
Independent anatomical alignment for new-mouse claim and measured full-workload resource bounds.
Isolated participant transport, authentic reference/scorer checks, and model interpretation trials.
implementation.execution_evidence: Package manifest states verification not_run; all22 qualification gates remain open. This revision inspects source only and performs no native scientific or model execution.

direct_observation.representation: Proposed bounded numeric calcium feature packet or faithful visual observation of the same allowed interval; full high-dimensional programme arrays are not already a no-tools episode.
direct_observation.boundary: Freeze representation and training demonstrations; expose no query labels or direction-coded events; score all original trials.
missing: No case presentation/response collection path for a direct observer; validate representation fidelity and coverage before comparison.

typed_viewer.representation: A calcium-viewing interface could expose the permitted premovement signals with typed actions; none is implemented for this task.
typed_viewer.boundary: No raw-array export, future frames or query label access; fixed action budget and same underlying observations.
missing: Task-specific typed renderer, action policy, complete answer capture and isolation evidence.

tool_assisted.representation: Internal source constructs per-case numeric training/query features and equal-arm specifications with Python/numpy/scipy/sklearn/supplied-reference tools.
tool_assisted.boundary: Case-local reset, no target feedback or test-batch adaptation; match packet digest, tools and declared resource limits with frozen programme.
missing: No participant callback/runner or adaptive transport is delivered; available operator preparation/reference/scoring functions do not execute this participant access mode.
Actual model process/provider, target isolation and authentic complete programme execution remain absent.

frozen_program.representation: Internal source defines a precommitted executable/fit recipe operating on the same numeric packet as the case-adaptive arm.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze recipe before query access; use only training labels and no query-batch fitting.
missing: No participant callback/runner or adaptive transport is delivered; available operator preparation/reference/scoring functions do not execute this participant access mode.
Public entry remains status-only; source construction is not programme performance or direct understanding.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: No model or human result is established by the inspected task source. The repository historical neural pilot concerned NEURAL-007 and NEURAL-077 programmes, not this task.
excluded_claims: No human baseline, native observer result, model accuracy or scientific qualification.
No online onset prediction, causal mechanism, or pooled16/25-class success.

summary: Made retrospective onset alignment and separate16/25-class, held-block/held-mouse estimands authoritative.
Replaced stale specification-only implication with inspected numerical scorer capability while retaining missing authentic provider.
Defined direct/viewer delivery gaps separately from source-available tools/programmes and required nuisance-matched biological-unit comparisons.
Separated preparation/reference/scoring source from participant access: frozen programme and adaptive tool execution are not delivered.
revision.source_review: Inspected the original task and actual mapping/features/split/packet/reference/grading/operator code. Reused detailed retained primary-source audit and rechecked the author repository; no authentic inputs were read.
